idea: Week two, from the story bank: written from the tables, then corrected by two independent editors before voicing.
description: Bihar's electricity available per person rose from 170.3 to 343.9 kWh a year between 2014-15 and 2024-25 (2.02 times, +102%) against India's 818.7 to 1,208.2 (+48%), taking Bihar from 21% to 28% of India's figure.
Available power per person, not use. Blank: Jammu and Kashmir (boundary changed); Ladakh and Dadra, Nagar Haveli, Daman and Diu (not in the table). The table shows how much, not why.
source: Central Electricity Authority, Ministry of Power, as published in the RBI Handbook of Statistics on Indian States, Table 138: per capita availability of power, kilowatt-hours a year. This is power available (net units), not power used. Per-person figures use the population projections the Handbook cites.
